name: PostgreSQL generated-key failure on slot creation
details: RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS makes the PostgreSQL driver return every column, so KeyHolder.getKey() throws and POST /provider/slots returns 500 on the runtime database. H2 tests could not catch it.
solution: prepareStatement(sql, new String[]{"slot_id"}); the same for appointment_id. Verified live on PostgreSQL.

name: Seed slots already in the past
details: Seed slots were fixed at 2026-09-27..29, so after that date every seed slot is unbookable (409) and the demo had nothing to book.
solution: Seed relative to CURRENT_DATE with portable interval arithmetic.

name: Browse listed past slots
details: OPEN slots that had already started were listed and counted, but booking them always returned 409.
solution: Filter start_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; tested in SlotControllerBrowseTest.

name: Removing a slot with cancelled history returned 500
details: Book → cancel → provider removes the slot: DELETE violates the appointments.slot_id foreign key and returns 500.
solution: Soft-cancel (status CANCELLED) when any appointment references the slot.

name: Frontend could not reach the API
details: The client on :5173 calls :8080 with credentials, but there was no CORS configuration, so the browser blocked every request.
solution: CorsConfig with an explicit origin list and allowCredentials; verified in headless Chrome.

name: Unknown routes returned 500
details: The catch-all Exception handler turned NoResourceFoundException / 405 / 415 into 500.
solution: Keep the ErrorResponse status for framework exceptions.

name: Session fixation on login
details: Login wrote the identity into the existing pre-login session instead of issuing a new one.
solution: Invalidate the old session and create a new one; tested.

name: Provider slot list capped at 10
details: The provider workspace read only page 1 of GET /slots?providerId=..., so slots beyond 10 could not be removed from the UI.
solution: Page through results until a short page; verified with 15 slots.
